{{Quote|In one battle above the world of Althir, my unit managed to defeat a force of Althiri ten times our own size.|Canderous Ordo|<ref name="Kotor" />}}
The '''Althiri''' were the inhabitants of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Althir III]]. During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was [[Battle of Althir (first)|assaulted]] by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]. Despite holding off the invaders for five [[Time/Legends|days]], the Althiri were eventually defeated. The Mandalorians were later [[Battle of Althir (second)|repelled]] from Althir by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces under the command of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]].

==History==
===Ship makers===
{{Quote|These Althiri don't seem too bright.''"<br />"''They weren't stupid. Stupid races don't make starships and weapons of mass destruction. But they weren't masters of art as the Mandalorians are.|Canderous to an amnesic Revan|<ref name="Kotor" />}}
The Althiri were the inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Kotor" /> [[Althir III]],<ref name="Warfare" /> a world with multiple rings,<ref name="Kotor" /> which was located in the [[Rolion sector/Legends|Rolion sector]] of the northern [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Althir system/Legends|Althir system]]</ref> They manufactured their own [[Starship/Legends|starships]] as well as producing weapons of mass destruction.<ref name="Kotor" />

===Invasion===
{{Quote|For five days they had managed to hold off our forces, keeping us to the outer rings of their world, preventing us from attacking it directly.|Canderous Ordo|<ref name="Kotor" />}}
In [[3976 BBY]],<ref name="Warfare" /> Althir was outside the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was one of the first two targets [[Battle of Althir (first)|attacked]] by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] in what would become known as the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> For five [[Time/Legends|days]], the Althiri held the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] at the outermost rings of their planet in a conflict that became known as the Battle of Althir, preventing them from directly assaulting their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. However, on the sixth day, Mandalorian [[Canderous Ordo]] led a feint against one of the Althiri flanks, designed to draw out the Althiri forces, allowing the rest of the Mandalorian task force to attack from the rear. The Althiri were not fooled by his maneuvers, however, and set about repelling the main force. In doing so, however, they split their [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], leaving the center of their fleet exposed. Ordo exploited this tactical failure, turning his forces to assault the center of the Althiri formation.<ref name="Kotor" />

The ponderous Althiri starships were unable to turn in time, and Ordo decimated their command vessels, defeating an Althiri force ten times the size of his own complement. With their leadership destroyed, the Althiri organization collapsed. The surviving starships scattered, with some attempting to cut across the plane of the rings in order to escape. These Althiri were shredded by the rings' [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], while others were slaughtered by Mandalorians. For his part in the battle, Ordo gained command of a subsect of [[Clan Ordo|his clan]].<ref name="Kotor" /> The conquest of Althir III gained the Mandalorians another industrial world for their war machine, and Althiri [[frigate]]s and [[corvette]]s soon supplemented the Mandalorian fleet.<ref name="Warfare" />

Sometime between [[3961 BBY|3976]] and [[3960 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the Galactic Republic attacked the Mandalorian forces on Althir in a [[Battle of Althir (second)|second Battle of Althir]], inflicting massive losses on the Mandalorian [[Army/Legends|army]] and winning the battle, one of a number of victories for the Republic under the leadership of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Later, when Revan fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], Althir became part of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|his Sith Empire]]. The Republic defeated the Sith Empire in [[3956 BBY]], and five years later scattered the [[Sith Triumvirate]] that had arisen to replace it. Following these victories, the Republic slowly reintegrated its lost territory.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[BioWare]] created the Althiri for ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2003]].<ref name="Kotor" />
